answerCheck.derivedAnswer: D, log(1+x)<x under the usual common-logarithm convention
answerCheck.reason: For common logarithms, g(x)=x-log10(1+x) has g(0)=0 and g'(x)=1-1/((1+x)ln 10)>0 for x>0, proving D. The natural-logarithm version also satisfies ln(1+x)<x.

flags: The logarithm base is unstated. D holds for the standard common and natural logarithm interpretations, but not uniformly for every admissible base.
